people.name: Ammihud
people.line: Father of Elishama, leader of Ephraim

people.name: Elishama
people.line: A leader from the tribe of Ephraim.

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

translations.web: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
translations.bsb: On the west side, the divisions of Ephraim are to camp under their standard: The leader of the Ephraimites is Elishama son of Ammihud,
translations.kjv: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
translations.asv: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their hosts: and the prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
